title: 多稼如云 Duojia Ruyun
subtitle: To Chia Ju Yun (Crops Bountiful as the Clouds) · Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 7 boxes stand in this compound, 7 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 御製多稼如雲詩（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製多稼如雲詩
坡有桃沼有蓮月地花天虹梁雲棟巍若仙居矣隔垣一方鱗塍參差野風習習襏襫蓑笠往來又田家風味也葢古有弄田用知稼穡之候云
稼穡艱難尚克知黍高稻下入疇諮弄田常有倉箱慶四海如兹念在兹
evidence.summary: After the peach slopes, lotus ponds and cloud-high buildings comes a walled plot of fish-scale fields, with farmers in rain capes coming and going. It is a modern 弄田, the plot the ancients kept to learn the seasons of farming.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處迤北對河外稻塍者為多稼如雲正宇五楹前宇為芰荷香正宇東稍南有室為湛緑（圓明園册）臣等謹按多稼如雲四十景之一軒額興芰荷香湛緑皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 濓溪樂處, facing paddies across the stream: 多稼如雲, a five-bay main range, 芰荷香 in front and 湛緑 to the east.

evidence.title: 多稼如云: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.250 item (2), under 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 永夏塞湖对君子，御园秋末有余芳。离披绿盖仍摇影，可识仙寰岁月长。讬根清净出泥中，回忆幽香送晚风。花谢花开视平等，幻成色相立虚空。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 多稼如云, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 多稼如云: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.250 item (3), under 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 塞苑嘉莲每岁咏，御园静植未能观。根仍茂密花全谢，一例西风落叶残。想象芙蕖拓净姿，朱华万柄耀朝曦。经霜摇落同芦苇，转瞬田田又满池。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 多稼如云, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 芰荷香北望
evidence.locator: v2 p.229, under 多稼如云; source ref 2-105
evidence.excerpt_zh: 蜃窗纳远景，春宇绘闲云。老树留曦影，轻风叠水纹。岚光相映带，淑霭互氤氲。农作期将近，耕畬事克勤。
evidence.summary: Poem 芰荷香北望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 多稼如云.

evidence.title: 多稼如云: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.251 item (6), under 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 十亩池塘万柄莲，花中君子品清妍。远香淡雅临风细，静影翩翻映日鲜。灿灿朱英出泥垢，亭亭翠盖罥波烟。虚庭茂对欣蕃育，净植含芳徧锦涟。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 多稼如云, 1807, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 多稼如云 四首以题为韵
evidence.locator: v2 p.230, under 多稼如云; source ref 2-230
evidence.excerpt_zh: 问余有何乐，所乐在时和。省岁筹晴雨，力田茂麦禾。生民纪周雅，良耜载豳歌。珠玉诚无用，惟祈万宝多。
evidence.summary: Poem 多稼如云 四首以题为韵 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 多稼如云.

evidence.title: Scene 24, 多稼如云 Duojia Ruyun
evidence.excerpt_other: There were extensive rice fields in this part of the garden.
evidence.summary: A few small buildings looking over lotus ponds, peach trees on a hillside and rice fields.

evidence.title: Attiret: the farming quarter
evidence.excerpt_other: There you see Fields, Meadows, Farm-houses, and little scatter'd Cottages; with Oxen, Ploughs, and all the Necessaries for Husbandry.
evidence.summary: A quarter set apart for farming, within the garden. S02 pp.89-91 places rice fields round scenes 20 to 26; which scenes it means is a guess.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
evidence.summary: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

evidence.title: 多稼如云, yaffin 系列09
evidence.summary: Lead: Yongzheng date, first called 观稼轩, north-east of 汇芳书院, with a large lotus pond in the south. Qianlong dined here with his mother; Jiaqing was lodged here on his accession. Unverified.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 多稼如云
evidence.locator: from p.250, under 多稼如云
evidence.summary: 多稼如云: 6 dated items, 1744-1807, of which 5 poems and 1 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1744, last dated 1807.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 多稼如云
evidence.summary: A farm scene: five-bay main hall, 颐和书屋, 湛渌, and the south hall 芰荷香 over a lotus pond, which held a set of the recut 淳化阁帖 and the 西洋楼 engravings.
